name: Cá khô kho rim
summary: Cá khô kho rim is dried fish simmered until the sauce coats it. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study pairs it with grilled dried fish in the daily rice. It calls dried seafood fragrant and prints no spice list and no stall price.
origin: Cham Islands. Dried seafood on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: Simmer the dried fish. The same study lists grilled dried fish as the other way to cook it.
With rice at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets. The study names no shop.
seoTitle: Cá khô kho rim — dried fish simmered, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Dried fish simmered until the sauce coats it, in the daily rice on Tân Hiệp. A stall price is Check on arrival.
